features.name: Prerequisite
features.description:
The dragonwarrior must worship Althena.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Dragonwarrior Techniques
features.description:
At 3rd level, the dragonwarrior gains the following techniques instead of the warrior techniques gained at 3rd level:

* **Power Up:** As a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) that costs 1 stamina, the dragonwarrior gains a +1 bonus to melee damage rolls for 1 round. This bonus increases by +1 for every 5 warrior levels beyond 3rd.
* **Vigor:** As a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) that costs 1 stamina, the dragonwarrior gains a +1 bonus to melee attack rolls for 1 round. This bonus increases by +1 for every 5 warrior levels beyond 3rd.

This ability alters warrior techniques.

features.name: Dragonmaster
features.description:
At 5th level, a dragonwarrior may qualify for the [dragonmaster](https://finalfantasyd20.com/classes/prestige-classes/dragonmaster/) prestige class, ignoring the base attack bonus and skill rank prerequisites.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Dragonwarrior Techs II
features.description:
At 5th level, the dragonwarrior can make use of the following dragonwarrior techniques:

* **Power Slash:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 1 stamina, the dragonwarrior deals double weapon damage (including Strength and applicable feat bonuses) to one target within melee range. If this attack would confirm a critical hit, the dragonwarrior does not apply the weapon’s critical multiplier. Instead, the attack deals an additional 1d6 damage per point of the weapon’s critical multiplier, plus 1d6 per two warrior levels (minimum +2d6).
* **Sword Dance:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 2 stamina, the dragonwarrior makes a full attack using a single weapon against a one creature within melee range. All attacks granted by this effect must target the same creature. The dragonwarrior makes one additional attack at his highest base attack bonus as part of this sequence.

This ability replaces additional techs II.

features.name: Dragonwarrior Techs III
features.description:
At 7th level, the dragonwarrior can make use of the following dragonwarrior techniques:

* **Flash Cut:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 1 stamina, the dragonwarrior moves up to 30 feet in a straight line, passing through allies and enemies without provoking attacks of opportunity. He makes a single attack roll at his highest base attack bonus and applies the result against each enemy within his melee reach during this movement.
* **Power Sweep:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 1 stamina, the dragonwarrior makes a single attack at his highest base attack bonus against all enemies within his melee reach.

This ability replaces additional techs III.

features.name: Dragonwarrior Techs IV
features.description:
At 9th level, the dragonwarrior can make use of the following dragonwarrior techniques:

* **Explosion Staff:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 2 stamina, the dragonwarrior leaps 15 feet forward, landing in a burst of flame. All enemies within 5 feet of his landing square take 1d6 points of fire damage per warrior level. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + half the warrior’s level + his Strength modifier) halves this damage.
* **Sonic Riser:** As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) that costs 2 stamina, the dragonwarrior cuts the very air with his weapon. All enemies in a 30-foot line take 1d6 points of wind damage per warrior level. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + half the warrior’s level + his Strength modifier) halves this damage.

This ability replaces additional techs IV.
